title: VCO Testbench
text: Validate voltage controlled oscillator (VCO) by measuring phase noise metrics or VCO characteristics, 1 input, 1 output; {Measurement} sets the target metric to be measured, {Set stop time} sets the recommended minimum simulation stop time as model stop time, {Plot measurement}, {Export measurement results}, {Control voltage (V)} sets the vCO control voltage, {Range of control voltage (V)} sets the range of VCO control voltages, {Autofill setup parameters} sets the automatically calculate setup parameters for phase noise measurement, {Resolution bandwidth (Hz)} sets the smallest positive frequency that can be resolved, {No. of spectral averages} sets the number of spectral averages, {Hold-off time (s)} sets the delays measurement analysis to avoid, {Autofill target metric} sets the automatically populate target phase noise metric, {Phase noise frequency offset vector (Hz)} sets the phase noise frequency offset vector and {Phase noise vector (dBc/Hz)} sets the phase noise vector. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Measurement
params.values: Target metric to be measured Phase noise (default) | Kvco and Fo

params.name: Set stop time
params.values: Set recommended minimum simulation stop time as model stop time button

params.name: Range of control voltage (V)
params.values: Range of VCO control voltages [2 7] (default) | two-element row vector

params.name: Autofill setup parameters
params.values: Automatically calculate setup parameters for phase noise measurement button

params.name: Resolution bandwidth (Hz)
params.values: Smallest positive frequency that can be resolved 30e3 (default) | real positive scalar

params.name: No. of spectral averages
params.values: Number of spectral averages 8 (default) | positive integer scalar

params.name: Hold-off time (s)
params.values: Delays measurement analysis to avoid transients 0 (default)

params.name: Autofill target metric
params.values: Automatically populate target phase noise metric button

params.name: Phase noise frequency offset vector (Hz)
params.values: Phase noise frequency offset vector [30e3 100e3 1e6 3e6 10e6] (default) | real valued vector

params.name: Phase noise vector (dBc/Hz)
params.values: Phase noise vector [-45 -55 -65 -75 -100] (default) | real valued vector
